notes.title: Patch Update 1.04
notes.content:
[p]Hello my friends!

A new patch is live, here what includes:

- Texts and GUI fixes[/p][p]- Directional help for new quests[/p][p]- Time Freeze ability bugs fixed[/p][p]- Minor bug fixes [/p][p]
Have fun! and if you have other feedback on what features you would like to see let us know!

- 

Also, we're working on:

- Camera Mode
- New upcoming DLC
- New unlockable items and weapons[/p]

notes.title: Mai: Child of Ages - Soundtrack available and Patch 1.02!
notes.content: [p]Hello my friends![/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Soundtrack DLC[/b] is now available on Steam to purchase, check out the page![/p][p][/p][p]It includes [b]50 pieces of music[/b] from the original game[/p][p align="start"](This Item will be updated with the release of every additional DLC.)[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3991730/Mai_Child_of_Ages_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Also Patch 1.02 is now available and includes:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixes for Chinese Traditional and Chinese Simplified translations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for Japanese and Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]A new patch is on the way too and will include several bug fixes based on your feedback,[/p][p]thank you so much for the support and keep us updates in the forum![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3499550/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3499550/discussions/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Mai: Child of Ages is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello my friends![/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Mai: Child of Ages[/b] is [b]OUT NOW[/b] for Steam and soon for all Consoles![/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]Check out the [b]Release Trailer:[/b] [/h3][h3] [/h3][h3][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XaoJqPljos4&ab_channel=ChubbyPixel"][/dynamiclink][/h3][p][/p][h3]- Embark on a journey through a [b]vast world[/b] brimming with mysteries, where you’ll encounter strange characters and uncover their stories.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]- Rewrite History –[/b] Bend time to your will and reshape the future according to your desires using Mai’s unique powers.[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h3]We’re also working on a [b]new FREE DLC that is coming soon,[/b][/h3][h3]It will include [b]new areas to explore and power ups[/b] to unlock.[/h3][p][/p][h3]so make sure to stay tuned on our Discord and socials for the latest updates![/h3][p][/p][h1][url="https://discord.com/invite/chubbypixel" style="button"]OUR DISCORD SERVER[/url][/h1][h1][url="https://www.youtube.com/@MalboM" style="button"]YOUTUBE CHANNEL[/url][/h1][p][/p][h3]Also don't forget to add the Soundtrack to your wishlists! 
(coming next week)[/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3991730/Mai_Child_of_Ages_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Also, if you have any feedback during your playthrough, don't hesitate to tell us on the discussion forum![/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3499550/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3499550/discussions/[/url][/p][p][/p]
